Dr. '''Lytos Urtell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] scientist, best known for his invention of [[SenseLights]], which contributed to fantastic light shows at the [[Glow Dome]] on [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]].

==Biography==
Lytos Urtell was employed at a high-level position within [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. He was let go for unknown reasons and his files were sealed so they cannot be accessed without high company security clearance. He was out of work until [[Corinna A'Daasha]] hired him to design [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] displays at her nightclub the [[Glow Dome]]. He was given a private office and lab where he could conduct his work in peace and he in turn designed their very popular light displays.

Urtell took the opportunity to wire the whole club for surveillance and has placed [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorders]] throughout the club. He also was able to perform research and create prototype systems, including a personal holoprojector prototype that could instantly disguise the wearer, and [[SenseLights]] which were an experiment in mind control. His prototype personal holoprojector was in high demand due to its usefulness in clandestine operations and it attracted the attention of both [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces as well those looking for personal gains like [[Cha Raas]] and [[Vallikor En-Vahdi]].

==Personality and traits==
Dr. Urtell was an odd and enigmatic scientist, even for a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]]. While he was left alone with his work he was content, quiet, and most of all fiercely private. He preferred to be left alone and was visibly uncomfortable during social interactions. He was very curious and explored his environment without boundaries. He had no reservations about recording hundreds of private conversations or trying to implant subliminal messages through light displays. Urtell viewed everyone and everything as a potential subject for experimentation.

==Skills and abilities==
Extremely gifted in matters of programming and engineering, Urtell was a genius when it came to mechanical and technical skills. He was highly trained in holophysics which explained why he was so adept at creating light displays. He also had a biology background that helped him associate how his holophysics would effect different alien physiologies.

==Equipment==
Urtell carried very little in way of unusual items. He had a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], a diagnostic scanner, and miscellaneous tools and lab equipment that aided in his research. He did carry around a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] for protection but he was not very good with it.

==Behind the scenes==
Lytos Urtell was designed by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]]. He was illustrated by [[Tom O'Neill]]. His name also appeared in [[Ultimate Alien Anthology]] as an example Sullustan name.
